textbookText: 21. Before the transfusion of blood to a patient, blood group of donor and receiver patient is checked by the doctor. Why? Ans:- To prevent agglutination and immune reaction caused by incompatible blood groups, which can be life-threatening. 22. Ramila gets tired even after walking a short distance and also feels difficult to breathe? What is the reason for this? Explain. Ans:- Likely due to anemia (low RBC or hemoglobin), reducing oxygen transport to tissues, causing fatigue and breathlessness. 23. While Sarita was walking on the road, she saw an old man suffering from chest pain. She rushed him to the hospital. The initial examination suggested that he might have a heart problem. Which test would be appropriate to identify his heart condition? Explain with reason. Ans:- Angiogram is appropriate to check for blocked coronary arteries, which can cause chest pain and heart problems. 24. Explain the main causes of a heart attack. Ans:- Main causes of a heart attack are i) Blockage of coronary arteries due to cholesterol plaque (atherosclerosis). ii) Blood clot formation in coronary arteries. iii) High blood pressure, stress, smoking, and diabetes also increase risk. 25. When Samip's blood was tested, the number of white blood cells was found to be 3000. Which symptoms may appear in his body in this situation? Give a reason. Ans:- Frequent infections, fever, weakness are the symptoms may appear in his body in this situation because Low WBC count (leukopenia) reduces body’s defense against pathogens. 26. The level of fibrinogen was found to be high in the plasma of Harish at the time of the blood test. Does this affect his blood circulation or not? Explain with a reason. Ans:- Yes. High fibrinogen increases blood viscosity and risk of clot formation, which may obstruct blood vessels and affect circulation.
